text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I heard her voice while I was running.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: DEEERRRBYYY!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I can't count how many times all her<n>silly yelling
has cheered me up.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But today, it terrified me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Why isn't anything working? Why<n>can't I...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Thanks, but... I wasn't good enough—I<n>lost.

She's quiet again, and I'm not quite<n>sure what to
say.

Before I can think of something, a<n>voice cuts
through the air.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, Winning Ticket!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wait, aren't you with...

text_block_list.name: Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I'm with the Winning<n>Step Weekly! Do
you have some time<n>for an interview?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Sure, I don't mind! Sorry I kept turning<n>you down!

text_block_list.name: Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, not at all! So tell me, how did<n>you feel about
the Derby?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I loved it. All that excitement andcheering? It was awesome! I felt like Iwas in a dream... But you knowwhat?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: It was even better than a dream!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...Even though I lost.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text: Well, there's always next time...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it's okay. I tried my best.<n>Winning the
Derby's been my dream<n>for so long, and I trained
as hard as I<n>could for it.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Sob... I did it all for the sake ofwinning this race! I really wanted towin!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
choice_data_list: Let's head back to the waiting room.
Let's head back to the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sure...

Biwa Hayahide doesn't utter a word<n>when she
returns to the waiting room.

She's just as crestfallen as she was<n>at the Satsuki
Sho...
choice_data_list:
Do you remember what happened at the Satsuki
Sho?

text_block_list.text:
Her shoulders jump. It appears she<n>does, and she
appears deep in<n>thought about something.
choice_data_list: What have you been thinking about since then?
What have you been thinking about since then?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sometimes, it's like you can read my<n>mind...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You always know what I'm thinking<n>about, down to
the exact moment.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I run, my head spins with<n>images of
future losses.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I've lost twice now. Once to Taishin at<n>the Satsuki
Sho, and again to Ticket at<n>the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We planned for so many scenarios<n>and tried to
anticipate so many<n>variables. But they just have
something I lack.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm scared. I don't know what thatsomething is, but if it's not just anoversight... If it's something I'mintrinsically missing, then beatingthem is impossible.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But I—
choice_data_list: We'll find out what's different about them.

text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide is extremely smart.<n>Smart enough
to figure out most<n>things on her own.

It's why she always tries to solve<n>everything
alone, even when facing<n>an insurmountable
challenge. But<n>sometimes, she needs a bit of
guidance.
choice_data_list: Why not try copying their strengths?
Why not try copying their strengths?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What?
choice_data_list:
The most fundamental way to learn is through
imitation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I get what you're saying, but they<n>both have
completely different<n>strengths. During races
they're—
choice_data_list: Okay, but what are they like outside of races?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Outside of races?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Before the Satsuki Sho, I thought<n>Taishin's drive
was amazing.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I thought same thing about her before<n>the Derby.
Her drive astounded me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I don't know why I thought that<n>though...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I tried my best. Winning the Derby's<n>been my
dream for so long, and I<n>trained as hard as I could
for it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes... Both of them have the iron will<n>to improve.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
They have the willingness to do<n>whatever it takes,
even if it breaks<n>them.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Going forward, don't be afraid topush me to my limits. In fact, I wantyou to make me work harder.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My body can handle the pressure.<n>I'm stronger
than I was as a child.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I don't ever want to taste defeat<n>again, and to
ensure that I don't, I<n>need to push myself harder!

Even after we return from the Tokyo<n>Racecourse to
the academy, her<n>resolve remains steely.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I won't ever lose again!

And so, with a determination<n>bordering on
obsession...

Biwa Hayahide sets her sights on the<n>final race of
the Classic Triple Crown<n>tour—the Kikuka Sho.
